text:
Avery: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for commercial strategy + partnerships Qs. I'll paste the high-level notes and open the thread for questions.

Avery: @Sam can you confirm ARR coverage target for Q3? Also want clarity on partner co-sell motions and enablement timeline. doc: https://redwood.internal/handbook/commercial/q3-goals

Sam: Target = $9.5M ARR coverage (assumes 2 major channel partners live). Will publish detailed pacing deck by EOD Monday. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya: Quick clarification — when you say "coverage" do you mean committed pipeline or weighted pipeline? that changes our forecast.

Sam: Good catch. Coverage = weighted pipeline at 60% conversion. I'll add a note in the deck.

Marco: Co-sell playbook is ready for review. Enablement week planned Apr 12-16, partner portal beta by May. Who owns partner enablement ops? @Devon?

Devon: I'll own enablement ops. Need 2 SEs from field for first wave. Can we prioritize marketplace listing for top 3 partners? that should increase partner-sourced leads.

Elaine: Product ask — what are the top 2 integration hooks partners want? We'll need API docs + quickstart templates. cc @eng-docs.

Marco: Partners are asking for quickstart and per-route performance SLAs for dedicated customers. Ops/security, any blockers?

OpsBot: No active incidents. SLA draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ops/sla-drafts

Avery: Action items: Sam publish deck by Mon EOD; Marco share partner portal milestone sprint on Thurs; Devon assign SEs; Elaine coordinate quickstarts with eng-docs. Drop +1 to confirm. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Priya: +1 — I'll draft a short FAQ for sales to handle partner objections and share by Wed.

Sam: Noted. We'll slot the FAQ into the deck. Thanks all.
